params.name: page
params.description: Número de la página. Si no se proporciona, se asume la primera página (1).

params.name: page_size
params.description: Tamaño de la página, con un valor máximo permitido de 100. Si no se proporciona, se utiliza un tamaño de página predeterminado (25).

items.docs: Este endpoint proporciona una lista paginada de recintos pertenecientes a una empresa específica. Cada recinto incluye detalles como el nombre, dirección y ubicación.

Retrieve information for each Recinto

A Recinto has the following attributes::
- name: Recinto name
- code: Recinto code
- location_id: ID of the Commune where the Recinto is located (you can check the endpoint GET /locations))
- city: City
- address_name: Street name of the Recinto
- address_number: Street number of the Recinto
- address_optional: Description of the address
- latitude: Latitude of the Recinto
- longitude: Recinto longitude
- postcode: Recinto Zip Code
- integrated_with_ctrl: I

Create a new Recinto in the system. The parameters are:

- name: Recinto name
- code: Recinto code
- location_id: ID of the Recinto location (you can check the endpoint GET /locations)
- address_name: Street name of the Recinto
- address_number: Street number of the Recinto 
- address_optional: Address description (OPTIONAL)
- latitude: Latitude of the Recinto (OPTIONAL)
- longitude: Longitude of the Recinto (OPTIONAL)
- postcode: Recinto Zip Code (OPTIONAL)
- establishment_code: Recinto Code (O

Updates an existing Recinto in the system. The parameters are:

The entered values will overwrite the data of the Recinto being edited.

- identifier: ID of existing Recinto
- name: Recinto name (OPTIONAL)
- code: Recinto code (OPTIONAL)
- location_id: ID of the Recinto location (you can check the endpoint GET /locations) (OPTIONAL)
- address_name: Street name of the Recinto (OPTIONAL)
- address_number: Street number of the Recinto \ (OPTIONAL)
- address_optional: Address description (OPTIONAL)
